source.author: verg
source.text: Hic Curibus fidens primaevo corpore Clausus advenit et rigida Dryopem ferit eminus hasta sub mentum graviter pressa pariterque loquentis vocem animamque rapit traiecto gutture; at ille fronte ferit terram et crassum vomit ore cruorem.
source.text_original: Hic Curibus fidens primaevo corpore Clausus / advenit et rigida Dryopem ferit eminus hasta / sub mentum graviter pressa pariterque loquentis / vocem animamque rapit traiecto gutture; at ille / fronte ferit terram et crassum vomit ore cruorem.
source.text_english: Here Clausus came, trusting in his youthful strength from Cures, and struck Dryopes from afar with a stiff spear, heavily driven beneath the chin, and with the throat pierced at once snatched away voice and life from the man as he was speaking; but he struck the ground with his forehead and spewed thick blood from his mouth.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin rapis hine animam et famulos citus effugis artus?
reuse.text_original: quin rapis hine animam et famulos citus effugis artus?
reuse.text_english: Why do you not snatch your soul from here and quickly escape your enslaved limbs?
